data.one_liner: Create single and multiple stacked circular progress bars with animation and gradients.
data.what_it_does: Provides single and multiple stacked circular progress bar widgets that support custom gradients, stroke widths, and animation durations.
use_when: You need to display single or stacked circular progress indicators in your Flutter app.
You want gradient or animated circular progress components.
avoid_when: You need linear or other non-circular progress indicators.
strengths: Supports both single and multiple stacked circular progress bars
Includes built-in animations and gradient color support
data.minimal_example:
Center(
  child: SingleSimpleStackCircularProgressBar(
    size: 200,
    progressStrokeWidth: 15,
    backStrokeWidth: 15,
    startAngle: 0,
    backColor: Color(0xffD7DEE7),
    barColor: Colors.red,
    barValue: 70,
  ),
)
